notes: Retires the old centered floating Weapon Tracker HUD as a player-facing interface.
The canonical FEHA firearm sheet is now the only weapon tracker UI for attack, damage, attacks remaining, reload progress, undo, and reset controls.
FEHA_RELOAD_TRACKER remains as a headless state/combat backend so existing attack tracking and reload logic continue to work without a second overlay.
Any legacy call to weaponTracker.open() now opens the canonical weapon sheet instead of recreating the retired floating HUD.
Loader initialization removes any already-open legacy floating tracker so hot reload immediately leaves only the new sheet tracker visible.
No firearm balance, manufacturer, armor, cyberware, grenade, or Quickhack rules changed.
